200.25.15.3(1).explanation: Transition rule: the listed parking regulations do not stop a building for which a complete Section 45 minor variance application was filed on or before July 22, 2022, or after that date in respect of a building permit referred to in 200.25.15.1(1).

200.25.15.3(2).explanation: Transition rule: the listed accessible parking regulations do not stop a building for which a complete Section 45 minor variance application was filed after July 22, 2022 and on or before March 31, 2025, or after that in respect of a building permit referred to in 200.25.15.1(2).

200.25.15.3(3).explanation: A complete application for a minor variance, for this transition, means one that meets Section 2 of Ontario Regulation 200/96 under the Planning Act.

200.25.15.3(4).explanation: For a qualifying project, a minor variance may be granted, and a building permit then issued, under the listed 970.10 parking regulations or under By-law 569-2013 as it read when the application was made (on or before July 22, 2022, or between July 22, 2022 and March 31, 2025), together with the approved variances.
